methods.name: Early quests, then trees and oaks
methods.note: Monk's Friend and three other quests give 9,000 XP, level 26. Otherwise regular trees to 15, then oaks to 35. Ironmen burn the logs.

methods.name: Teak trees
methods.note: Drop the logs. Fastest without tick tricks up to 65. Rates assume felling axes with rations from 61. Ironmen bank teaks for planks.

methods.name: Teak trees (1.5-tick)
methods.note: Tick-perfect 1.5-tick on teaks you planted on Fossil Island. Fastest Woodcutting XP in the game but very click-intensive.

methods.name: Wintertodt
methods.note: Ironmen take Woodcutting from about 50 to 60 here while training Firemaking, then buy a rune axe at the Woodcutting Guild.

methods.name: Yews with Forestry events
methods.note: Chop yews on a Forestry world (388, 444, 487 or 510) and join the events. Decent XP plus anima-infused bark for the shop.

methods.name: Blisterwood tree
methods.note: Darkmeyer tree that never depletes, with a sound cue when you stop chopping. Sins of the Father only needs to be partly done.

methods.name: Sulliusceps
methods.note: Tar Swamp mushrooms on Fossil Island. Fast without tick manipulation and gives fossils. Bring antipoison and some food. Dragon axe rates.

methods.name: Camphor trees
methods.note: The Great Conch, Troubled Tortugans only partly needed. The Sacred Grove spot (after The Red Reef) has a deposit box. Forestry events spawn.

methods.name: Bloodwood trees
methods.note: Vampyrium, tapping three trees at once into buckets of sap. Fastest without tick manipulation. Over 210,000 with a crystal felling axe.

methods.name: Engorged bloodwood tree
methods.note: Single large tree south of the Ruined Village in Vampyrium. Far fewer clicks than the three-tree spot and the sap still sells.

methods.name: Ironwood trees
methods.note: Sunbleak Island, 14 trees. Over 110,000 with a crystal felling axe and rations. The bank chest there needs 70 Construction to build.

methods.name: Redwood trees
methods.note: Woodcutting Guild. Needs very little attention. Drop the logs or fletch them into shafts. A crystal axe reaches 70,000 to 75,000.

methods.name: Rosewood trees
methods.note: Drumstick Isle. A tree lasts about 4 minutes 35 seconds, so it is very low effort. No bank on the island, drop the logs.

unverified: Early quests, then trees and oaks: no rate is given at these levels; the page's level-99 table lists regular trees at 12,500 to 18,750 and oaks at 40,000
Teak trees: section table used (93,000 at 99); the level-99 table says 90,000 without tick manipulation. 2-tick teaks (78,000 to 215,000) left out
Teak trees (1.5-tick): Farming 35 for planting teaks comes from Farming training, not the Woodcutting guide; table is a long-term benchmark for a practised player
Wintertodt: the Ironman Guide gives no Woodcutting rate; the level range 50 to 60 is as the guide heads it
Yews with Forestry events: the only rate is 80,000 to 90,000 at level 99; nothing at 60

Blisterwood tree: page says up to about 69,000 before 90 and up to 86,000 with a crystal felling axe and rations; 85% of each used; the level-99 table says 85,000. Needs Sins of the Father partly done, not completed
Sulliusceps: main guide dragon axe column used (82,700 to 101,900); the Ironman Guide says 100,000 to 110,000
Camphor trees: only 70,000 at level 99 is given; nothing at 66. Needs Troubled Tortugans partly done, not completed
Bloodwood trees: 130,000 to 210,000 with a dragon felling axe is not tied to a level; midpoint used as a flat rate
Engorged bloodwood tree: page says upwards of 70,000, used as written
Ironwood trees: main guide says around 80,000 with a dragon axe, the Ironman Guide says 80,000 to 100,000
Redwood trees: section says 55,000 to 60,000 at 90 and 65,000 at 99 with a dragon axe; the level-99 table says 70,000 to 85,000; the Ironman Guide says more than 60,000
Rosewood trees: 85,000 to 90,000 when dropping logs, midpoint used; no rate by level
